name: Slot Machine
description: Digits spin then lock into place left to right.
legacyScript: function animate(env,el,p){ var t=el.text,n=Math.round(t.length*env.time),o=""; for(var i=0;i<t.length;i++){ var c=t.charAt(i); if(i<n||!/\d/.test(c)){o+=c;} else { var r=(AM.simplexNoise(i*2.1+env.absTime*p.speed,p.seed)+1)/2; o+=""+Math.floor(r*10)%10; } } el.text=o; return el; }
